headers.rowSteps_nil: (es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i j : ℕ) : rowSteps es i j [] = 1
headers.rowSteps_cons:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i j : ℕ) (w : ℚ) (ws : List ℚ) :
    rowSteps es i j (w::ws) = StoredSample.entrySteps (i,j) es+2+rowSteps es i (j+1) ws
headers.rowValues_length:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i j : ℕ) (r : List ℚ) :
    (rowValues es i j r).length=r.length
headers.values_length:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i : ℕ) (W : Weights) :
    (values es i W).length=W.length
headers.entry_lift:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i j : ℕ) (w : ℚ) (ws : List ℚ)
    (acc : List SampleRecords.Entry) (rs : Weights) (out : SampleRecords.Records)
    {k : ℕ} {s t : StoredSample.State} (h : Trace (StoredSample.transition (i,j) w es) k s t) :
    Trace (transition es) k (.entry i j w ws acc rs out s) (.entry i j w ws acc rs out t)
headers.cell_trace:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i j : ℕ) (r : List ℚ)
    (acc : List SampleRecords.Entry) (rs : Weights) (out : SampleRecords.Records) :
    Trace (transition es) (rowSteps es i j r) (.cell i j r acc rs out)
      (.revRow i rs out ((rowValues es i j r).reverse++acc) [])
